retained_capabilities.name: Native Call codec-core execution defaults
retained_capabilities.semantics: ExecutionResources supplies an optional positive native-int CallConfig codec-core budget, through the selected SDK media factory, to both send and receive codec settings. Absent preserves native detection; an explicit native CallConfig value wins. This necessary transitive input lives in call/call_config.h outside the SDK directory tables. It is not a complete standalone Call/CallConfig binding or proof of backend worker ownership/replay. Existing standalone codec settings are not rewritten.

retained_capabilities.name: Linux camera device information and capture
retained_capabilities.semantics: Retain the existing CameraDeviceInfo, camera option/provider, format selection and camera capture APIs. The upstream roots are modules/video_capture/video_capture.h, video_capture_factory.h and video_capture_options.h, outside native-api.md's directory list. This is not a claim to expose every implementation header in modules/video_capture.

retained_capabilities.name: Linux desktop capture options, providers and frames
retained_capabilities.semantics: Retain existing screen/window/generic capture, options, source-list callbacks, provider and frame APIs. The public consumer roots are modules/desktop_capture/desktop_capturer.h, desktop_frame.h, desktop_capture_options.h and delegated_source_list_controller.h; the existing PipeWire lifecycle bridge additionally uses linux/wayland/base_capturer_pipewire.h. Physical display/portal behavior is an explicit native boundary, not deterministic simulation or a complete binding product for every desktop_capture implementation class.
